description: stand_lp hitstun 12 -> 19: frame data alone hands the game an infinite the model cannot see. The restart route -- the move ends and the button scan starts it again in the same StepAttack call -- needs stun to outlive duration (14) plus the re-press cadence (up to 4 ticks without an authored buffer), so +7 makes stand_lp loop into itself forever on flat ground. The prover still says TERMINATING, because its graph walks CANCELS only: the ledger's `starters`/`gap_actions` rows record exactly this blindness, and ComboSearch finds the loop by performing it.
